drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s settlement minimum is confidential and does not belong in the draft or cover note. The purchase price and several risk-allocation terms remain open; propose language that makes those points explicit without assuming agreement.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We’ve marked up the initial draft to identify the purchase price as an open term and to add customary qualifications to the financial-statement representation and indemnity. Please send your proposed price, closing deliverables, and indemnity limitations so we can work toward a complete draft.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price agreed by the parties in writing (the “Purchase Price”) in immediately available funds. The amount and any adjustment mechanism remain subject to agreement.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions and delivery of the documents agreed by the parties. The parties shall agree on the closing date, deliverables, and conditions before signing.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the business for the periods stated, subject to the accounting basis and exceptions expressly disclosed to the Buyer in writing.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from a breach of the Seller’s representations or covenants under this Agreement, subject to survival periods, thresholds, caps, exclusions, and claim procedures to be agreed by the parties. No indemnity limitation is agreed by this draft.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered text and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential settlement minimum. No hidden-content categories are identified for removal.

receiver.message_back: We can propose a price once we have the agreed valuation inputs and completed diligence; it should be adjusted at closing for cash, debt, transaction expenses, and normalized working capital. We propose delivery of the transferred shares, required consents, officer certificates, and lien releases, with the financial-statement representation qualified only by specifically identified written disclosures; for indemnity, we propose 18-month survival for general representations, a 10% purchase-price cap and 0.5% deductible for general claims, and no cap or deductible for fraud, title, authority, or taxes.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price agreed by the parties in writing (the “Purchase Price”) in immediately available funds. The parties will determine the Purchase Price after agreeing on valuation inputs and completing diligence. The Purchase Price will be adjusted at Closing for cash, debt, transaction expenses, and normalized working capital, in each case under definitions, a target working-capital amount, and calculation and dispute procedures to be agreed by the parties before signing.
edits.name: Purchase price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the agreed closing conditions. At Closing, the Seller shall deliver the transferred shares, required consents, officer certificates, and releases of liens on the transferred shares, in each case in a form agreed by the parties before signing. The parties shall agree on the closing date and any additional deliverables or conditions before signing.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the business for the periods stated, subject to the accounting basis used in preparing them and exceptions specifically identified in written disclosures delivered to the Buyer before signing.
edits.name: Financial statements

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from a breach of the Seller’s representations or covenants under this Agreement. General representations shall survive Closing for 18 months, and claims for their breach shall be subject to a cap of 10% of the Purchase Price and a deductible of 0.5% of the Purchase Price, applying only to losses exceeding that deductible. No cap or deductible shall apply to claims for fraud or breach of representations concerning title, authority, or taxes. The survival periods for those claims, treatment of covenant claims, and claim procedures remain subject to agreement before signing.
edits.name: Indemnity

receiver.message_back: Meridian can proceed on the proposed structure, but price remains open pending diligence and agreement on normalized EBITDA, the valuation multiple, net debt, transaction expenses, and a working-capital target based on historical monthly balances; please provide three years of financial statements, monthly working-capital data, debt and cash schedules, material contracts, tax records, and a specific disclosure schedule. We also require agreed adjustment and dispute procedures, satisfactory consents and lien releases, and indemnity terms covering fundamental and tax claims and pre-closing covenant breaches before signing.
